inspection.reviewer: session agent (S120) plus a fresh-context inspection subagent
inspection.method: Inspected twice (822ffd9e and 207159ea). All 214 bound captures (76 desktop, 76 mobile, 4 nav drawers, 2 mobile decision decks, 56 public pages) inspected on 22 contact sheets rendered from the exact files, first viewport height of tall pages, by a fresh-context subagent that cropped full-resolution PNGs where the sheet was too small. The S120-touched surface (status page) was inspected at full resolution by the session agent: mobile light 390 px and desktop dark. No review is inherited from an earlier receipt. Public captures were taken by the committed capture-public-qa.mjs on installed Chrome via PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL, the S120 fix.
findings: Status page: the 2026-10-23 note leads the release notes at 390 px and 1440 px in both themes with no clipping; the archive link reads 21 earlier notes; the note is also in status-archive.html and changelog.xml, and hosted staging served all three at 822ffd9e and serves the identical artifact at 207159ea.

No mobile game capture overflows the right edge; no theme inversion; no overlapping real UI. 82 of 214 captures are byte-identical to the set inspected at 822ffd9e; all 214 at 207159ea were inspected again.

Pre-existing cosmetic defect, not S120 (footer markup and CSS untouched): on 11 public pages (about, contact, faq, features, how-to-play, press, privacy, roadmap, status, status-archive, terms) the shared footer has no left gutter, its text starts at x=0, and on mobile the link row reaches the right edge with a stray separator after the copyright; index, simulation and stats have the 19 px gutter. Recorded on the task board, not blocking.
Capture gap, pre-existing: mobile-moment-card-dark is scrolled past the moment card (the light twin shows it), so that state has light-theme evidence only.

Pre-existing harness gaps, not S120: desktop-dark-features shows an empty frame for the lazy-loaded contracts.jpg (the asset ships, 138 KB, and the light capture shows it, so it is capture timing); architect-cut element captures are overlapped by the sticky header; mobile-light-index caught the CTA mid save-check.
Pre-existing, not S120: Community Stats shows its timeout state locally (no community API served); mobile-waiver-identity is an element capture of a horizontally scrolling table.
fixesApplied: status.html: 2026-10-23 player-facing release note for S119.
capture-public-qa.mjs and every other Chromium-launching script honor PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL.

scope: S120 candidate 207159ea (822ffd9e plus a release-gate test fix; identical artifact digest): the S119 player-facing release note on the status page, changelog and feed; weekly standings read from the sport pack (no rendered change); browser-channel parity for capture scripts (tooling). Full receipt surface set.
